 Zydus Wellness, an FMCG leader, develops, manufactures, and markets health and wellness products,

title: Outbound Sales Executive ? US Market
description:
Job Category Business DevelopmentSales & Support About the role We are building a dedicated outbound sales team to grow our US customer base. This is a hunting role. You will be the first human contact a prospective customer has with us: researching accounts, making the first call, earning a conversation, and booking qualified meetings. You will not be waiting for leads to come to you. We are hiring five to six people into this team at the same time, so you will ramp alongside peers rather than alone, with structured coaching from day one. What you will do Make 60 to 80 outbound calls per shift to US-based small and mid-sized businesses, alongside supporting email and LinkedIn outreach Open conversations with people who were not expecting your call, and earn the right to the next few minutes Qualify prospects against our fit criteria business type, size, current tooling, intent and budget Book qualified meetings for the senior sales team and hand over clean, well-documented context Log every call, outcome and next step in the CRM the same shift, without exception Learn the products well enough to connect a customer's actual problem to what we do Handle objections and rejection without losing warmth or momentum Share what you are hearing from the market in daily standups so the team gets better together Follow all applicable US calling and email regulations, and the call guidelines you will be trained on What we are looking for Essential 0 to 3 years in outbound calling, international sales, or a US voice process Clear, confident spoken English and a neutral accent that US customers understand easily Genuine resilience the ability to be told no repeatedly and pick up the phone again Strong listening skills; able to ask a second and third question rather than reciting a pitch Comfortable working a permanent night shift from our Noida or South Delhi office Basic comfort with CRM tools and everyday digital software Graduate in any discipline English fluency sufficient to hold an unscripted business conversation with a US decision-maker Preferred Schooling from a reputed Delhi school, international school or undergraduate/postgraduate study at a university in the UK or US Prior exposure to Western business culture, whether through study, work or an international process Experience selling SaaS, software or a subscription product Experience selling into the US market specifically Who tends to do well here People who are curious about a stranger's business rather than eager to talk about ours People who treat a "no" as information, not as a verdict on them People who want to be coached and will act on feedback within the week What we offer Compensation up to 50,000 per month + target based incentives Weekly one-to-one coaching, including recorded call reviews with your manager Clear progression into Senior Sales Executive roles Company-provided door-to-door cab transport for the night shift Statutory benefits per company policy A team being built from scratch, where how we work is still open to your influence

Job description We are building an ecosystem. We need people who can open doors in Government and win the bids behind them. 
 About Sambhav Sambhav is Indias first Discrete Ecosystem Orchestrator, bringing together 29 specialised scopes across 9 verticals to deliver integrated solutions to enterprises and Government institutions. We work across logistics technology, enterprise and defence technology, and EdTech and workforce skilling. Sambhav operates online under the brand Hum Dekh Lenge (www.humdekhlenge.com). 
 The role You will build Sambhavs Government business end to end: finding the right tenders and departments, checking that we qualify, putting together compliant bids with our partner organisations, and following each one through to award. One successful bid can open doors across several verticals. It suits someone who is as comfortable in a pre-bid meeting as with an eligibility checklist and a submission deadline. 
 Key responsibilities Government business development Identify and map target ministries, departments, PSUs and state agencies relevant to Sambhavs verticals Build relationships with officials, procurement teams and nodal officers, and track upcoming projects before tenders are published Attend pre-bid meetings, department visits and industry forums across Delhi NCR Work with partner organisations to form the right combination of scopes for each opportunity Tender management Track tenders, RFPs and EOIs daily on GeM, CPPP and state e-procurement portals, and shortlist those worth pursuing Study tender documents and corrigenda, and check eligibility and pre-qualification criteria before a bid decision Maintain a tender tracker with deadlines, status, EMD and bid security details, and outcomes Manage vendor registrations and empanelments on Government portals and keep them current Bid management Prepare complete technical and financial bids, including compliance statements, BOQs, declarations and supporting credentials Coordinate inputs, authorisations and documents from internal teams and partner organisations against the submission timeline Raise pre-bid queries, submit bids on the portals, and handle post-bid clarifications Follow up through evaluation to award, and coordinate work orders, agreements and performance security after a win Keep the Firms statutory and commercial documents (registrations, certificates, financials, experience records) bid-ready at all times 
 Who should apply 0–3 years of experience in tender or bid management, Government sales or business development; freshers with strong drive are welcome Working familiarity with GeM and e-procurement portals is a strong plus, as is willingness to learn Government procurement rules quickly Strong attention to detail and the discipline to meet submission deadlines without follow-up Comfort meeting Government officials and following up persistently Clear written and spoken communication in English and Hindi, including formal letter and document drafting Good command of MS Office or Google Workspace for bid documents and trackers An ownership mindset and willingness to travel across Delhi NCR 
 We actively encourage women to apply.
